safety.photosensitivity_desc: BackSilence contains dynamic water caustic reflections and CRT tracking distortions. Photosensitive safe mode eliminates rapid flicker (clamped to <= 3 Hz) and limits luminance transitions.
safety.headphones_desc: The subterranean entity is completely blind and relies entirely on water acoustics. Binaural stereo audio is essential to pinpoint threats and survive.
safety.content_desc: Atmospheric psychological survival horror, drowned municipal architecture, isolation, and sensory dread. No gore or human violence.
safety.hardware_desc: Calibrated 60 FPS target with volumetric water reflections and spatial audio reverb.
safety.orientation_desc: A 90-second non-lethal acoustic calibration course in Sector 0. Learn how footsteps, wading, and splashes echo before descending into the drowned complex.
